{{Top|leg}}
An '''elephant''' was said to be a creature as large as a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], though without the bantha's tremendous looped horns.<ref name="Zorba the Hutt's Revenge">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref> The shape of an elephant's head was similar to that of a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back (novel)">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']]</ref> The term "white elephant" was sometimes used to describe an unwanted ornament.<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> [[Falumpaset/Legends|Falumpasets]] were compared to elephants.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref>

The [[Pryss-creature]]s of [[Verig]] were large, elephantine beasts.<ref name="Assault on Hoth">''[[Assault on Hoth]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
An elephant never appears in any canonical source, though is often mentioned when describing other things in the galaxy, such as a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]. A elephant did make an Easter egg appearance in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', in the level "Liberty on Ryloth"<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>, based on the episode "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]."<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

Real elephants were significant in the production of the ''Star Wars'' films. In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], an Asian elephant named [[Mardji]] played the bantha.<ref name="Bantha - Databank">{{DB|creature|bantha|bantha}}</ref> The movements of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] seen in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] were based on footage of Mardji walking.<ref name="Empire's Elephant">{{SWArchive|url=episode-v/explore/classic/2001/10/classic20011031.html|text=Empire's Elephant - Classic Moments Snapshot}}</ref>

Elephants were also used in the sound design of the films. The sound of a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter's]] engines were the result of mixing cars streaking past and the trumpeting cry of an elephant.<ref name="TIE Fighter - Databank">{{DB|starship|tiefighter|TIE fighter}}</ref>

For [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], the design characteristics of the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] were based on a massive elephant.<ref name="Trade Federation MTT - Databank">{{DB|vehicle|tfed_mtt|Trade Federation MTT (Multi Troop Transport)}}</ref>
